main_body: Flat grass ground patch, a repeating 16x16 tile pattern of mid green with lighter green tufts and a few dark green specks. It is terrain, not a standing object.
top_band: none (terrain tile, no standing volume; a single column shows mid green with light and dark green tuft pixels)
evidence: The candidate is a seamless grass ground texture. It has no standing body, so the top-band and front-face contract does not apply. It has no front-elevation or side-face construction, and as terrain it is acceptable.

style.evidence: The grass uses a mid green base with light-green tufts and a few dark-green specks, so about 3 steps. The 16px tile repeats identically 4x3 times, which makes a visible mechanical pattern. The base is large areas of one flat green, and the tufts are sparse, regular and blocky clusters. The Beodeul grass reference has more tonal variation, finer grain and clumps in several greens, with an irregular layout. There is no outline, which is fine for ground. Overall it is flatter and thinner than the reference, with fewer colours per tile.
